description: Everything a careful buyer (or their AI assistant) needs before paying Yazılım Koçu, as verifiable facts: legal name, tax office and number, founding year; live client projects published with written permission (URLs to check) and our own products, clearly separated; the reference policy (design demos on /tasarimlar are fictional, not client work); customer reviews collected only via a personal invite link with e-mail verification (count, average, latest - removed reviews stay listed with the reason); contract terms: transfer of project-specific source code rights, design guarantee (full refund until design approval, web packages), 50%/50% payment on projects, free support period. Nothing here is a marketing claim; each item links to the page or contract clause that states it. No input.
name: due_diligence
title: Firma doğrulama (referans, yorum, güvenceler)
